def facts():
    b = Buffer("KTPU", 8, dtypes.float).allocate()
    st = b._buf
    vals = np.array([1.5, -2.25, 3, 4, 5, 6, 7, 0.5], np.float16)
    DEV.write(st.form(FM.F16, 16).addr, vals.tobytes())
    st.wrote(FM.F16)
    st.dtype = np.dtype(np.float32)
    out = np.empty(8, np.float32)
    TinyDevice["KTPU"].allocator._copyout(memoryview(out).cast("B"), st)
    b.deallocate()
    return {"values": out.tolist()}
